        "run-tool",
        "tool-budget",
        "inject-payload",
        "prime",
        "set",
        "vars",
    }
    matrix = (
        Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
        / "docs/planning/active/command-refactor/validation/command-matrix.json"
    )
    rows = json.loads(matrix.read_text())["commands"]
    expected = {row["name"] for row in rows if row["name"] not in retired}
    aliases = {
        alias for row in rows if row["name"] not in retired for alias in row["aliases"]
    }
    assert friday_v2_commands == expected | aliases
    assert reference_commands - friday_v2_commands == retired

async def test_app_exits_cleanly_on_eof() -> None:
    runtime = build_runtime(_config({"llm": {"model": "openai/test-chat-model"}}))
    output = ListOutputSink()
    app = FridayChatApp(
        runtime=runtime,
        input_source=ListInputSource(["hello"]),
        output_sink=output,
    )

    result = await app.run()

    assert result.exit_reason == "eof"
    assert result.turns_processed == 1
    assert output.values == ["Friday: hello"]
    assert result.maintenance_actions == (
        "flush_pending_extraction",
        "flush_memory",
        "run_lifecycle",
    )
    assert app.started is False
    assert app.background.closed is True
    assert app.background.pending_count == 0
    assert isinstance(runtime.async_clients, FakeAsyncClientLifecycle)
    assert runtime.async_clients.close_calls == 1
    assert isinstance(runtime.transcript, FakeTranscriptStore)
    assert runtime.transcript.finalized is True

async def test_async_clients_close_after_background_and_llm_maintenance() -> None:
    runtime = build_runtime(_config({"llm": {"model": "openai/test-chat-model"}}))
    app = FridayChatApp(runtime=runtime, input_source=ListInputSource([]))

    class RecordingLifecycle:
        def __init__(self) -> None:
            self.background_closed = False
            self.maintenance_actions: tuple[str, ...] = ()

        async def close(self) -> None:
            self.background_closed = app.background.closed
            self.maintenance_actions = tuple(runtime.maintenance.actions)

    lifecycle = RecordingLifecycle()
    runtime.async_clients = lifecycle

    await app.run()

    assert lifecycle.background_closed is True
    assert lifecycle.maintenance_actions == (
        "flush_pending_extraction",
        "flush_memory",
        "run_lifecycle",
    )

async def test_async_client_cleanup_failure_is_bounded_and_contained() -> None:
    runtime = build_runtime(_config({"llm": {"model": "openai/test-chat-model"}}))

    class FailingLifecycle:
        async def close(self) -> None:
            raise RuntimeError("provider payload must not be rendered")

    runtime.async_clients = FailingLifecycle()

async def test_app_injects_one_gate_and_chat_turn_waits_for_exclusive() -> None:
    runtime = build_runtime(_config({"llm": {"model": "openai/test-chat-model"}}))
    output = ListOutputSink()
    app = FridayChatApp(
        runtime=runtime,
        input_source=ListInputSource(["hello"]),

    )
    assert app.reorganization_coordinator.gate is app.maintenance_gate
    assert app.background_work.gate is app.maintenance_gate

    entered = asyncio.Event()

    async def hold_exclusive() -> None:
        async with app.maintenance_gate.exclusive("test-maintenance"):
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()

    exclusive = asyncio.create_task(hold_exclusive())
    await entered.wait()
    running = asyncio.create_task(app.run())
    await asyncio.sleep(0)

    assert not running.done()
    assert output.values == []
    release.set()
    await exclusive
    result = await running
    assert result.turns_processed == 1
    assert output.values == ["Friday: hello"]

async def test_extraction_interval_matrix() -> None:
    async def scheduled_intervals(interval: int, turns: int) -> list[str]:
        runtime = _runtime(extraction_interval=interval)
        manager = BackgroundTaskManager()
        coordinator = BackgroundWorkCoordinator(runtime, manager)
        for turn in range(1, turns + 1):
            coordinator.schedule_after_turn(
                turn_count=turn,
                user_message=f"u{turn}",
                assistant_message=f"a{turn}",
            )
        await manager.wait_for_all()
        return [
            action
            for action in runtime.maintenance.background_actions

async def test_preempted_extraction_is_requeued_and_resumed(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    runtime = _runtime(extraction_interval=3)
    manager = BackgroundTaskManager()
    coordinator = BackgroundWorkCoordinator(runtime, manager)
    extraction_started = asyncio.Event()
    extraction_completed = asyncio.Event()
    unrelated_release = asyncio.Event()
    extraction_attempts = 0

    unrelated_task = manager.create_task(unrelated_release.wait())

    async def controlled_extraction(*, trigger_reason: str) -> int:
        nonlocal extraction_attempts
        extraction_attempts += 1
        turns = list(runtime.maintenance.pending_extraction)
        runtime.maintenance.pending_extraction.clear()
        if extraction_attempts == 1:
            extraction_started.set()
            try:
                await asyncio.Event().wait()
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                runtime.maintenance.pending_extraction[:0] = turns
                raise
        runtime.maintenance.background_actions.append(
            f"extract:{trigger_reason}:{len(turns)}"
        )
        extraction_completed.set()
        return len(turns)

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        runtime.maintenance,
        "extract_buffered_turns",
        controlled_extraction,
    )
    coordinator.schedule_after_turn(
        turn_count=3,
        user_message="foreground priority",
        assistant_message="defer extraction",
    )
    await asyncio.wait_for(extraction_started.wait(), timeout=1.0)

    assert await coordinator.preempt_extraction_for_foreground_turn() is True
    assert len(runtime.maintenance.pending_extraction) == 1
    pending = runtime.maintenance.pending_extraction[0]
    assert isinstance(pending, PendingExtractionTurn)
    assert pending.user_message == "foreground priority"
    assert pending.assistant_message == "defer extraction"
    assert pending.turn_id
    assert unrelated_task.done() is False

    coordinator.resume_preempted_extraction()
    unrelated_release.set()
    await asyncio.wait_for(extraction_completed.wait(), timeout=1.0)
    await manager.wait_for_all()

    assert extraction_attempts == 2
    assert unrelated_task.cancelled() is False
    assert runtime.maintenance.pending_extraction == []
    assert "extract:foreground_resume:1" in (
        runtime.maintenance.background_actions
    )

async def test_app_completes_background_work_while_next_prompt_is_idle() -> None:
    runtime = _runtime(
        extraction_interval=1,
        compaction_enabled=True,
        compaction_threshold=0.5,
        context_window=512,
        output_buffer=100,
    )
    prompt = FirstTurnThenIdlePrompt("x" * 2000)
    app = FridayChatApp(
        runtime=runtime,
        input_source=ConsoleInputSource(prompt_fn=prompt),
        output_sink=ListOutputSink(),
    )

    try:

        await asyncio.wait_for(app.background.wait_for_all(), timeout=1.0)

        assert app_task.done() is False

            runtime.maintenance.background_actions

        assert len(runtime.maintenance.compaction_calls) == 1
    finally:
        prompt.release.set()
        result = await asyncio.wait_for(app_task, timeout=1.0)

    assert result is not None
    assert result.exit_reason == "eof"
    assert result.turns_processed == 1
    assert app.background.closed is True

async def test_cancelled_background_extraction_is_deferred_or_flushed_at_shutdown(
    shutdown: bool,
) -> None:
    runtime = _runtime(extraction_interval=0)
    manager = BackgroundTaskManager()
    gate = MaintenanceAdmissionGate()
    coordinator = BackgroundWorkCoordinator(runtime, manager, gate)
    entered = asyncio.Event()
    release = asyncio.Event()

    async def hold_exclusive() -> None:
        async with gate.exclusive("test-maintenance"):
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()

    exclusive = asyncio.create_task(hold_exclusive())
    await entered.wait()
    coordinator.schedule_after_turn(
        turn_count=1,
        user_message="cancelled",
        assistant_message="not admitted",
    )
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    assert manager.pending_count == 3
    assert len(runtime.maintenance.pending_extraction) == 1
    pending = runtime.maintenance.pending_extraction[0]
    assert isinstance(pending, PendingExtractionTurn)
    assert pending.user_message == "cancelled"
    assert pending.assistant_message == "not admitted"
    assert pending.turn_id
    assert runtime.maintenance.background_actions == []

    hooks = AppMaintenanceRuntimeHooks(runtime, manager, coordinator)
    await hooks.prepare_for_manual_maintenance()
    if shutdown:
        await hooks.close_for_shutdown(snapshot_requested=True)
        assert runtime.maintenance.pending_extraction == []
        assert runtime.maintenance.actions[:2] == [
            "flush_pending_extraction",
            "flush_memory",
        ]
    else:
        drain_result = await hooks.drain_for_manual_maintenance()
        assert drain_result.buffered_extraction_count == 1
        assert drain_result.extraction_preempted is True
        assert runtime.maintenance.pending_extraction == [pending]
        assert runtime.maintenance.actions == ["flush_memory"]

    assert manager.pending_count == 0
    assert manager.failures == []
    assert manager.closed is shutdown

    release.set()
    await exclusive
    if not shutdown:
        resume_result = hooks.resume_after_manual_maintenance()
        assert resume_result.required is True
        assert resume_result.scheduled is True
        await manager.wait_for_all()
        assert runtime.maintenance.pending_extraction == []
        assert "extract:maintenance_resume:1" in (
            runtime.maintenance.background_actions
        )
        coordinator.schedule_after_turn(
            turn_count=2,
            user_message="admitted",
            assistant_message="processed",
        )
        await manager.wait_for_all()
        assert "extract:background_interval:1" in (
            runtime.maintenance.background_actions
        )

            "flush_pending_extraction",
            "flush_memory",
        ]
    else:
        drain_result = await hooks.drain_for_manual_maintenance()
        assert drain_result.buffered_extraction_count == 1
        assert drain_result.extraction_preempted is True
        assert runtime.maintenance.pending_extraction == [pending]
        assert runtime.maintenance.actions == ["flush_memory"]

    assert manager.pending_count == 0
    assert manager.failures == []
    assert manager.closed is shutdown

    release.set()
    await exclusive
    if not shutdown:
        resume_result = hooks.resume_after_manual_maintenance()
        assert resume_result.required is True
        assert resume_result.scheduled is True
        await manager.wait_for_all()
        assert runtime.maintenance.pending_extraction == []
        assert "extract:maintenance_resume:1" in (
            runtime.maintenance.background_actions
        )
        coordinator.schedule_after_turn(
            turn_count=2,
            user_message="admitted",
            assistant_message="processed",
        )
        await manager.wait_for_all()
        assert "extract:background_interval:1" in (
            runtime.maintenance.background_actions
        )

async def test_real_app_cli_pty_command_uat_is_contained_and_provider_free(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    prohibit_provider_and_network_transports: None,
) -> None:
    """Exercise the exact Gate F slash-command sequence through real adapters."""
    if os.name != "posix":
        pytest.skip("PTY command UAT requires a POSIX platform")

    state_root = tmp_path / "friday-chat-command-uat"
    state_root.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.chdir(state_root)
    config = _config_derived_from_example(state_root)
    _assert_contained_config_paths(config, state_root)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        adapters,
        "build_framework_embedding_service",
        lambda _config: FrameworkEmbeddingService(
            service=DeterministicEmbeddingBackend()
        ),
    )
    runtime = build_runtime(config, fake=False, session_id=CURRENT_SESSION_ID)
    _assert_contained_runtime(runtime, state_root)
    memory = _framework_memory(runtime)
    transcript = _framework_transcript(runtime)
    tools = _framework_tools(runtime)

    await _seed_transcript(
        transcript,
        session_id=CURRENT_SESSION_ID,
        user_message="current transcript UAT marker",
        assistant_message="current assistant UAT marker",
    )
    await _seed_transcript(
        transcript,
        session_id=SEEDED_SESSION_ID,
        user_message="selected transcript UAT marker",
        assistant_message="selected assistant UAT marker",
    )
    await _seed_memory(memory)

    model = SchemaRecordingChatModel()
    runtime.chat_llm = model
    automatic_turn = await TurnProcessor(runtime).process(
        "echo this deterministic schema selection"
    )
    assert automatic_turn.selected_tool_names == ("echo",)
    assert automatic_turn.tool_budget_snapshot is not None
    assert model.tool_payloads == [(tools.definitions[0],)]
    assert automatic_turn.tool_budget_snapshot.schema_bytes == (
        canonical_tool_schema_bytes(model.tool_payloads[0])
    )
    assert tools.calls == []

    commands = (
        "/sessions",
        "/transcript",
        f"/transcript {SEEDED_SESSION_ID}",
        "/memory",
        "/meta",
        "/tools",
        "/tool-budget",
        "/inject-tools echo",
        "/tool-budget",
        "/clear-tools",
        "/cls",
        "/clearscreen",
        "/q",
    )
    scripted_prompt = ScriptedPrompt(commands)
    master_fd, slave_fd = os.openpty()
    pty_chunks: list[bytes] = []
    reader = threading.Thread(
        target=_drain_pty,
        args=(master_fd, pty_chunks),
        daemon=True,
        name="friday-chat-uat-pty-reader",
    )
    try:
        with os.fdopen(slave_fd, "w", encoding="utf-8", closefd=True) as slave:
            console = Console(
                file=slave,
                force_terminal=True,
                color_system=None,
                width=240,
            )
            monkeypatch.setattr(display_module, "get_console", lambda: console)
            cli_display = FridayCliDisplay(
                config=CLIConfig.defaults(),
                banner=BannerDisplayConfig(enabled=False),
            )
            recording_display = RecordingPtyDisplay(cli_display)
            app = FridayChatApp(
                runtime=runtime,
                input_source=FridayCliInputSource(
                    recording_display.prompt_text(
                        user_name=config.chat.user_name,
                    ),
                    prompt_fn=scripted_prompt,
                ),
                output_sink=FridayCliOutputSink(),
                display=recording_display,
            )

            reader.start()
            result = await app.run()
            console.file.flush()
        reader.join(timeout=5.0)
        assert not reader.is_alive(), "PTY reader did not observe slave closure"
        pty_bytes = b"".join(pty_chunks)
    finally:
        os.close(master_fd)

    output = _strip_ansi(pty_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
    assert result.exit_reason == "command_exit"
    assert result.turns_processed == 0
    assert scripted_prompt.index == len(commands)
    assert scripted_prompt.prompts == [f"{config.chat.user_name}: "] * len(commands)
    assert recording_display.clear_calls == 2
    assert pty_bytes.count(b"\x1b[2J") == 2
    assert pty_bytes.count(b"\x1b[H") >= 2

    assert f"- {CURRENT_SESSION_ID} (2 turns) [current]" in output

async def test_real_app_cli_pty_command_uat_is_contained_and_provider_free(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    prohibit_provider_and_network_transports: None,
) -> None:
    """Exercise the exact Gate F slash-command sequence through real adapters."""
    if os.name != "posix":
        pytest.skip("PTY command UAT requires a POSIX platform")

    state_root = tmp_path / "friday-chat-command-uat"
    state_root.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.chdir(state_root)
    config = _config_derived_from_example(state_root)
    _assert_contained_config_paths(config, state_root)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        adapters,
        "build_framework_embedding_service",
        lambda _config: FrameworkEmbeddingService(
            service=DeterministicEmbeddingBackend()
        ),
    )
    runtime = build_runtime(config, fake=False, session_id=CURRENT_SESSION_ID)
    _assert_contained_runtime(runtime, state_root)
    memory = _framework_memory(runtime)
    transcript = _framework_transcript(runtime)
    tools = _framework_tools(runtime)

    await _seed_transcript(
        transcript,
        session_id=CURRENT_SESSION_ID,
        user_message="current transcript UAT marker",
        assistant_message="current assistant UAT marker",
    )
    await _seed_transcript(
        transcript,
        session_id=SEEDED_SESSION_ID,
        user_message="selected transcript UAT marker",
        assistant_message="selected assistant UAT marker",
    )
    await _seed_memory(memory)

    model = SchemaRecordingChatModel()
    runtime.chat_llm = model
    automatic_turn = await TurnProcessor(runtime).process(
        "echo this deterministic schema selection"
    )
    assert automatic_turn.selected_tool_names == ("echo",)
    assert automatic_turn.tool_budget_snapshot is not None
    assert model.tool_payloads == [(tools.definitions[0],)]
    assert automatic_turn.tool_budget_snapshot.schema_bytes == (
        canonical_tool_schema_bytes(model.tool_payloads[0])
    )
    assert tools.calls == []

    commands = (
        "/sessions",
        "/transcript",
        f"/transcript {SEEDED_SESSION_ID}",
        "/memory",
        "/meta",
        "/tools",
        "/tool-budget",
        "/inject-tools echo",
        "/tool-budget",
        "/clear-tools",
        "/cls",
        "/clearscreen",
        "/q",
    )
    scripted_prompt = ScriptedPrompt(commands)
    master_fd, slave_fd = os.openpty()
    pty_chunks: list[bytes] = []
    reader = threading.Thread(
        target=_drain_pty,
        args=(master_fd, pty_chunks),
        daemon=True,
        name="friday-chat-uat-pty-reader",
    )
    try:
        with os.fdopen(slave_fd, "w", encoding="utf-8", closefd=True) as slave:
            console = Console(
                file=slave,
                force_terminal=True,
                color_system=None,
                width=240,
            )
            monkeypatch.setattr(display_module, "get_console", lambda: console)
            cli_display = FridayCliDisplay(
                config=CLIConfig.defaults(),
                banner=BannerDisplayConfig(enabled=False),
            )
            recording_display = RecordingPtyDisplay(cli_display)
            app = FridayChatApp(
                runtime=runtime,
                input_source=FridayCliInputSource(
                    recording_display.prompt_text(
                        user_name=config.chat.user_name,
                    ),
                    prompt_fn=scripted_prompt,
                ),
                output_sink=FridayCliOutputSink(),
                display=recording_display,
            )

            reader.start()
            result = await app.run()
            console.file.flush()
        reader.join(timeout=5.0)
        assert not reader.is_alive(), "PTY reader did not observe slave closure"
        pty_bytes = b"".join(pty_chunks)
    finally:
        os.close(master_fd)

    output = _strip_ansi(pty_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
    assert result.exit_reason == "command_exit"
    assert result.turns_processed == 0
    assert scripted_prompt.index == len(commands)
    assert scripted_prompt.prompts == [f"{config.chat.user_name}: "] * len(commands)
    assert recording_display.clear_calls == 2
    assert pty_bytes.count(b"\x1b[2J") == 2
    assert pty_bytes.count(b"\x1b[H") >= 2

    assert f"- {CURRENT_SESSION_ID} (2 turns) [current]" in output
    assert f"- {SEEDED_SESSION_ID} (1 turns) [primed]" in output
    assert f"Transcript: {CURRENT_SESSION_ID}" in output
    assert "current transcript UAT marker" in output
    assert f"Transcript: {SEEDED_SESSION_ID}" in output
    assert "selected transcript UAT marker" in output
    assert f"- session_id: {CURRENT_SESSION_ID}" in output
    assert "- episodic_current_session_turns: 2" in output
    assert "- short_term: 2" in output
    assert "- long_term: 1" in output
    assert "- decayed: 0" in output
    assert "- nodes: 2" in output
    assert "- relationships: 1" in output
    assert "Gate F synthesized meta insight." in output
    assert "provenance=synthesis" in output
    assert "Decayed records: excluded" in output
    assert "echo" in output
    for removed in ("tool-budget", "inject-tools", "clear-tools"):
        assert (
            f"Unknown command: /{removed}. Type /help for available commands." in output
        )

    assert runtime.session_identity.value == CURRENT_SESSION_ID
    assert app.session.identity == runtime.session_identity
    assert app.command_context.session_identity == runtime.session_identity
    assert runtime.tool_selection.mode is ToolSelectionMode.AUTOMATIC
    assert runtime.tool_selection.manual_names == ()
    assert runtime.tool_selection.last_automatic_snapshot is not None
    assert runtime.tool_selection.last_automatic_snapshot.selected_names == ("echo",)
    post_clear_budget = await _execute(runtime, "/tool-budget")
    assert (
        post_clear_budget
        == "Unknown command: /tool-budget. Type /help for available commands."
    )
    assert tools.calls == []

assert "selected transcript UAT marker" in output

def test_production_clear_emits_control_sequence_through_pty(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    import pty

    master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
    try:
        with os.fdopen(slave_fd, "w", buffering=1, encoding="utf-8") as slave:
            console = Console(file=slave, force_terminal=True, color_system="standard")
            monkeypatch.setattr(display_module, "get_console", lambda: console)
            display = FridayCliDisplay(
                resolve_display_config(config_path=None).config
            )

            display.clear_screen()
            slave.flush()
            ready, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 1.0)
            assert ready == [master_fd]
            emitted = os.read(master_fd, 128)
    finally:
        os.close(master_fd)

    assert b"\x1b[2J" in emitted
    assert b"\x1b[H" in emitted

async def test_input_source_yields_while_prompt_is_pending(
    source_factory: InputSourceFactory,
    expected_prompt: str,
) -> None:
    controlled_prompt = ControlledPrompt()
    source = source_factory(controlled_prompt)
    manager = BackgroundTaskManager()
    background_completed = asyncio.Event()
    read_task = asyncio.create_task(source.read())

    async def mark_background_complete() -> None:
        background_completed.set()

    result = ""
    try:
        await asyncio.wait_for(controlled_prompt.entered.wait(), timeout=1.0)
        manager.create_task(mark_background_complete())
        await asyncio.wait_for(background_completed.wait(), timeout=1.0)
        assert read_task.done() is False
    finally:
        controlled_prompt.release.set()
        result = await asyncio.wait_for(read_task, timeout=1.0)
        await manager.close()

    assert result == "  unchanged response  "
    assert controlled_prompt.prompts == [expected_prompt]

async def test_prompt_reader_preserves_application_exception_handler() -> None:
    class RecordingPromptSession:
        def __init__(self) -> None:
            self.calls: list[tuple[str, bool]] = []

        async def prompt_async(
            self,
            prompt: str,
            *,
            set_exception_handler: bool,
        ) -> str:
            self.calls.append((prompt, set_exception_handler))
            return "response"

    session = RecordingPromptSession()

            "messages": list(messages),
            "tools": [{"type": "function", "function": {
                "name": "echo", "description": "Synthetic echo",
                "parameters": {"type": "object"},

            "temperature": 0.0,
            "max_tokens": 123,
            "timeout": 10.0,
        }

def test_all_role_factories_preserve_model_selection_and_injection(tmp_path, monkeypatch, mode, enabled):
    config = configured(tmp_path, mode)
    sink = ChatTelemetryObserver(enabled=True, session_id=SECRET) if enabled else None
    # Store, extraction and compaction collaborators are inert; no readiness or persistence.
    for name in ["MemoryExtractor", "InSessionCompactor", "ContextBudgetMonitor", "PassageRouter"]:
        monkeypatch.setattr(adapters, name, fake_backend)
    primary = adapters.build_framework_chat_model(config, telemetry=sink).service
    embedding = adapters.build_framework_embedding_service(config, telemetry=sink).service
    assert_service(primary, sink, "primary")
    assert_service(embedding, sink, "embedding")
    assert primary.model == ("openai/qwen3.8" if mode != "legacy" else "gpt-4")
    assert embedding.model == ("openai/nomic-embed" if mode == "canonical" else "text-embedding-3-small")
    default = adapters._build_legacy_primary_llm_service(config, telemetry=sink)
    assert_service(default, sink, "maintenance_default")
    router = adapters._build_passage_router(config, telemetry=sink)
    assert_service(router.llm, sink, "passage_router")
    for role in ROLES:
        service = adapters._build_role_llm_service(config, role, "gpt-4", telemetry=sink)
        assert_service(service, sink, "maintenance_" + role)
    for role in ["summarizer", "synthesizer"]:
        service = adapters._build_smart_file_llm_service(config, role=role,
                    default_name="smart_file_" + role, telemetry=sink)
        assert_service(service, sink, "smart_file_" + role)
    extraction = adapters._build_extraction_llm_service(config, default, telemetry=sink)
    assert_service(extraction, sink, "extraction")
    memory = NS(controller=NS(graph=object()), collection_manager=object(), access_buffer=None)
    diagnostics = NS(framework_upgrade_gaps=[])
    maintenance = adapters.build_framework_maintenance_adapter(config, session_id=SECRET,
        memory=memory, embedding=NS(service=embedding), llm_models={r: "gpt-4" for r in ROLES},
        diagnostics=diagnostics, maintenance_layout=NS(), telemetry=sink)
    assert not diagnostics.framework_upgrade_gaps
    assert_service(maintenance.extractor.llm, sink, "extraction")
    if mode == "canonical":
        assert_service(maintenance.compactor.llm_client, sink, "compaction")
    else:
        assert maintenance.compactor.llm_client is maintenance.llm_services["researcher"]
        assert_service(maintenance.compactor.llm_client, sink, "maintenance_researcher")
    registry = build_explicit_maintenance_provider_registry(config, telemetry=sink)
    assert not registry.configuration_errors
    for role, provider in registry.llms.items():
        assert_service(provider.service, sink, "maintenance_" + role.value)
    assert_service(registry.embedding.service, sink, "maintenance_embedding")
    if sink is not None:
        assert sink.snapshot().events == ()

async def test_real_chat_observer_and_composite_preserve_scalars_without_content(tmp_path, monkeypatch, mode):
    left, right = DebugTelemetryRecorder(), DebugTelemetryRecorder()
    sink = ChatTelemetryObserver(enabled=False, session_id=SECRET,
                                 provider=CompositeProvider([left, right]))
    service = adapters.build_framework_chat_model(configured(tmp_path, mode), telemetry=sink)
    raw = NS(choices=[NS(message=NS(content=SECRET, tool_calls=[], reasoning_content=SECRET),
                        finish_reason="stop")], usage=NS(prompt_tokens=3, completion_tokens=4, total_tokens=7))
    dispatch = AsyncMock(return_value=raw)
    monkeypatch.setattr(litellm, "acompletion", dispatch)
    result = await service.complete([{"role": "user", "content": SECRET}])
    assert result.content == SECRET and dispatch.await_count == 1
    assert [e.name for e in sink.snapshot().events] == ["llm.request_start", "llm.attempt_finish", "llm.request_finish"]
    assert [(e.name, e.data) for e in left.events] == [(e.name, e.data) for e in right.events]
    assert len(left.events) == 3
    end = dict(sink.snapshot().events[-1].attributes)
    assert isinstance(end["duration_ms"], float) and end["total_tokens"] == 7
    assert len(end["session_ref"]) == 16
    assert SECRET not in repr(sink.snapshot())
    # Legacy/foreign/malformed payloads never bypass the closed parser.
    payload = RequestStart(request_id="1" * 32, operation="chat", api="typed_completion",
                           service_role="primary", model_ref="2" * 32).model_dump(exclude={"name"})
    for fields in [{"content": SECRET}, {"session_ref": "0" * 16}, {"schema_version": True}]:
        sink.capture_event("llm.request_start", payload | fields)
    sink.capture_event("llm_completion_success", {"content": SECRET})
    assert len(left.events) == 3 and sink.snapshot().rejected_count == 4

async def test_manual_and_exit_share_production_coordinator_capability(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    root = tmp_path.resolve()
    config = FridayChatConfig.model_validate(
        {
            "llm": {"model": "openai/test-chat-model"},
            "embedding": {"model": "openai/test-embedding-model"},
            "memory": {"persist_directory": str(root / "vector")},
            "lifecycle": {
                "enabled": True,
                "access_buffer": {"enabled": False},
            },
            "transcript": {"export_directory": str(root / "exports")},
            "maintenance": {
                "backup_directory": str(root / "recovery"),
                "logging": {"log_directory": str(root / "logs")},
            },
            "session": {
                "reorganize_on_exit": True,
                "reorganize_mode": "fast",
            },
            "tools": {"registry": []},
        }
    )
    runtime = build_runtime(config, fake=False, session_id="capability-test")
    app = FridayChatApp(runtime=runtime)
    capability = app.reorganization_coordinator.execution_capability
    observed: list[ReorganizationRequest] = []
    exit_requests: list[ReorganizationRequest | None] = []

    async def observe_run(
        request: ReorganizationRequest,
        **_kwargs: object,
    ) -> ReorganizationResult:
        observed.append(request)
        return ReorganizationResult(
            status=ResultStatus.COMPLETED,
            trigger=request.trigger,
            mode=request.mode,
        )

    async def observe_shutdown(
        request: ReorganizationRequest | None,
        **_kwargs: object,
    ) -> None:
        exit_requests.append(request)

    monkeypatch.setattr(app.reorganization_coordinator, "run", observe_run)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        app.reorganization_coordinator,
        "shutdown",
        observe_shutdown,
    )

    _, manual = await app.command_registry.execute(
        "/reorganize --backup --execute",
        app.command_context,
    )
    await app._shutdown_through_coordinator()

    assert capability.memory_participant is True
    assert capability.transcript_participant is True
    assert capability.runtime_hooks is True
    assert capability.mutation_adapter is True
    assert capability.mutation_available is True
    assert runtime.maintenance.reorganization_execute_status()[0] is False
    assert manual is not None
    assert "Reorganization execute is disabled" not in manual.output
    assert [request.mode for request in observed] == [ReorganizationMode.BACKUP]
    assert len(exit_requests) == 1
    exit_request = exit_requests[0]
    assert exit_request is not None
    assert exit_request.mode is ReorganizationMode.FULL
    assert exit_request.skip_synthesis is True
    assert exit_request.skip_verify is True
    assert capability.available_for(observed[0]) is True
    assert capability.available_for(exit_request) is True

    fake_app = FridayChatApp(runtime=build_runtime(config))
    fake_capability = fake_app.reorganization_coordinator.execution_capability
    assert fake_capability.mutation_available is False
    assert fake_capability.recovery_available is False

assertions.source: assert "Reorganization execute is disabled" not in manual.output

    tmp_path: Path, processes, caplog
) -> None:
    runtime = build_runtime(cfg())
    bridge = install(runtime, tmp_path)
    native = tuple(bridge.native.list_tools())
    baseline_tasks = set(asyncio.all_tasks())
    try:
        await runtime.start_mcp_tools()
        assert tuple(bridge.native.list_tools()) == native
        assert bridge.tool_metadata["mcp_peer_read_file"].original_name == "Read.File"
        await runtime.start_mcp_tools()
        assert len(processes) == 1
        runtime.tool_selection.inject_manual(("mcp_peer_read_file",))
        runtime.chat_llm = FakeChatModel(
            "fake",
            responses=[
                ChatModelResponse(
                    tool_calls=(
                        ToolCallRequest("mcp_peer_read_file", {"path": "a/b"}, "call1"),
                    )
                ),
                ChatModelResponse.from_text("done"),
            ],
        )
        client = bridge.provider.manager.get_client("peer")
        original = client.call_tool
        routed = []

        async def record_route(name, arguments):
            routed.append((name, arguments))
            return await original(name, arguments)

        client.call_tool = record_route
        result = await TurnProcessor(runtime).process("read fixture")
        assert routed == [("Read.File", {"path": "a/b"})]
        call = result.tool_calls[0]
        assert call.arguments == {} and "a/b" not in call.result
        assert call.mcp_provenance.status == "succeeded"
        assert call.mcp_provenance.tool.original_name == "Read.File"
        assert call.mcp_provenance.failure_code is None
        registry = build_default_registry()
        context = RegistryCommandContext(runtime=runtime, registry=registry)
        for command in ("/tools", "/tool-budget", "/recommend-tools read fixture"):
            handled, output = await registry.execute(command, context)
            assert handled and output is not None
            assert "SENTINEL-STDERR-SECRET" not in output.output
        await runtime.stop_mcp_tools()
        assert (
            bridge.provider.manager is not None
            and bridge.provider.manager.connected_servers == []
        )
        assert bridge.provider.owned_tool_names == ()
        assert bridge.tool_metadata == {}
        assert bridge.list_tools() == native
        assert all(
            p.returncode is not None and p.stdout.at_eof() and p.stderr.at_eof()
            for p in processes
        )
        assert not [t for t in asyncio.all_tasks() - baseline_tasks if not t.done()]
        assert "SENTINEL-STDERR-SECRET" not in caplog.text
    finally:
        await runtime.stop_mcp_tools()

    tmp_path, processes, caplog, case, status, code
):
    runtime = build_runtime(config())
    recorder = DebugTelemetryRecorder()
    bridge = install(runtime, tmp_path, telemetry=recorder)
    before = set(asyncio.all_tasks())
    try:
        await bridge.start()
        record = await bridge.call_tool_record(
            "mcp_peer_read_file", {"case": case, "value": ARGUMENT}, call_id="call1"
        )
        assert record.arguments == {}
        assert (
            record.mcp_provenance.status == status
            and record.mcp_provenance.failure_code == code
        )
        assert record.mcp_provenance.tool.original_name == "Read.File"
        assert len(record.result.encode()) <= 256
        assert (
            ARGUMENT not in repr(record)
            and ERROR not in repr(record)
            and UNSAFE not in repr(record)
        )
        assert all(s not in caplog.text for s in (ARGUMENT, ERROR, UNSAFE))
        expected_reason = code or ("truncated" if case == "large" else "checked")
        assert recorder.get_event("mcp.tool_output_decision")["reason"] == expected_reason
        assert all(
            value not in repr(recorder.events)
            for value in (ARGUMENT, ERROR, UNSAFE, "WS05_OMITTED_TAIL")
        )
        if case == "large":
            assert (
                record.mcp_provenance.result_truncated
                and "WS05_OMITTED_TAIL" not in record.result
            )
        if case == "success":
            direct = await bridge.call_tool("mcp_peer_read_file", {})
            assert (
                direct.startswith("<untrusted_content") and len(direct.encode()) <= 256
            )
        await bridge.stop()
        assert_stopped(bridge, processes)
        assert not [t for t in asyncio.all_tasks() - before if not t.done()]
    finally:
        await bridge.stop()

        )

            and UNSAFE not in repr(record)

async def test_new_session_omits_mcp_launch_material_from_every_export(
    tmp_path, processes, caplog, streaming, fallback
):
    # Headers are forbidden by the accepted stdio config. Exercise header/URL
    # copies in supported launch arguments without introducing HTTP authority.
    peer = tmp_path / (LAUNCH + ".py")
    audit = tmp_path / "launch-audit.json"
    peer.write_text(
        "import json, os, runpy, sys\n"
        f"with open(sys.argv[1], 'w') as out: json.dump({{"
        f"'env_exact': os.environ.get('REM006_ENV') == {ENVIRONMENT!r}, "
        f"'args_exact': sys.argv[2:] == {[LAUNCH, 'Authorization: ' + HEADER, 'https://synthetic.invalid/?token=' + HEADER]!r}"
        "}, out)\n"
        f"runpy.run_path({str(execution_security.PEER.resolve())!r}, run_name='__main__')\n"
    )
    values = config().model_dump()
    server = values["tools"]["providers"]["mcp"]["config"]["servers"][0]
    server.update(
        command=sys.executable,
        args=[
            str(peer),
            str(audit),
            LAUNCH,
            "Authorization: " + HEADER,
            "https://synthetic.invalid/?token=" + HEADER,
        ],
        env={"REM006_ENV": ENVIRONMENT},
    )
    values["tools"]["providers"]["native_example"] = {"shape": "preserved"}
    if fallback:
        values["tools"]["loop"] = {"max_iterations": 1}
    configuration = FridayChatConfig.model_validate(values)
    original = configuration.model_dump(mode="json")
    runtime = build_runtime(configuration)
    bridge = install(runtime, tmp_path)
    store = SQLiteTranscriptStore(tmp_path / "private.sqlite")
    runtime.transcript = FrameworkTranscriptAdapter(store, configuration, "private")
    runtime.chat_llm = FakeChatModel(
        "fake",
        responses=[
            ChatModelResponse(
                tool_calls=(
                    ToolCallRequest("mcp_peer_read_file", {"case": "success"}, "call1"),
                )
            ),
            ChatModelResponse(
                tool_calls=(ToolCallRequest("mcp_peer_read_file", {}, "pending"),)
            )
            if fallback
            else ChatModelResponse.from_text("done"),
        ],
    )
    chunks = []

    async def capture(text):
        chunks.append(text)

    try:
        await runtime.start_mcp_tools()
        runtime.tool_selection.inject_manual(("mcp_peer_read_file",))
        processor = TurnProcessor(runtime)
        result = (
            await processor.process_streaming("synthetic", on_chunk=capture)
            if streaming
            else await processor.process("synthetic")
        )
        assert json.loads(audit.read_text()) == {
            "env_exact": True,
            "args_exact": True,
        }
        assert configuration.model_dump(mode="json") == original
        assert "Read.File" in result.tool_calls[0].result
        assert result.tool_calls[0].mcp_provenance.tool.original_name == "Read.File"
        session = await store.get_session("private")
        expected = configuration.model_dump(
            mode="json", exclude={"tools": {"providers": {"mcp"}}}
        )
        assert session.config_snapshot == expected
        assert session.config_snapshot["tools"]["providers"] == {
            "native_example": {"shape": "preserved"}
        }
        entry = (await store.get_entries("private"))[0]
        assert entry.tool_calls[0].mcp_provenance.transcript_correlation_id == entry.id
        captured = repr(session) + repr(entry) + repr(result) + repr(chunks)
        captured += repr(runtime.chat_llm.calls) + caplog.text
        captured += repr(await store.get_context_log_for_session("private"))
        for exporter, options in [
            (JSONLExporter(store), {"include_metadata": True}),
            (JSONLExporter(store), {"include_metadata": False}),
            (MarkdownExporter(store), {}),
            (MarkdownExporter(store), {"include_tool_calls": True}),
            (CSVExporter(store), {}),
        ]:
            output = io.StringIO()
            await exporter.export_session("private", output, **options)
            captured += output.getvalue()
            if isinstance(exporter, JSONLExporter):
                payloads = [json.loads(line) for line in output.getvalue().splitlines()]
                assert payloads[0]["config_snapshot"] == expected
                assert ("tool_calls" in payloads[-1]) == options["include_metadata"]
        folder = tmp_path / "all-csv"
        assert await CSVExporter(store).export_all_sessions(folder) == {
            "sessions": 1,
            "entries": 1,
        }
        for path in folder.glob("*.csv"):
            captured += path.read_text()
        session_row = next(
            csv.DictReader(io.StringIO((folder / "sessions.csv").read_text()))
        )
        assert json.loads(session_row["config_snapshot"]) == expected
        assert all(s not in captured for s in (ENVIRONMENT, HEADER, LAUNCH))
        assert (
            result.assistant_message.startswith("Tool results:")
            if fallback
            else (result.assistant_message == "done")
        )
        await bridge.stop()
        assert_stopped(bridge, processes)
    finally:
        await bridge.stop()

async def test_later_native_claims_rebind_complete_mcp_pairs_across_iterations(
    tmp_path, processes, production, streaming, fallback
):
    runtime = build_runtime(config())
    runtime.config.tools.loop["max_iterations"] = 3
    bridge = install(runtime, tmp_path)
    store = SQLiteTranscriptStore(tmp_path / "collision.sqlite")
    if production:
        runtime.transcript = FrameworkTranscriptAdapter(store, runtime.config, "pairs")

    class LaterNativeModel(FakeChatModel):
        async def complete(self, messages, *, tools=()):
            number = len(self.calls)
            if number == 0:
                response = ChatModelResponse(
                    tool_calls=(
                        ToolCallRequest("mcp_peer_read_file", {}, "shared"),
                        ToolCallRequest("mcp_peer_read_file", {}, "stable"),
                    )
                )
            elif number == 1:
                response = ChatModelResponse(
                    tool_calls=(
                        ToolCallRequest("echo", {"text": "native one"}, "shared"),
                        ToolCallRequest("mcp_peer_read_file", {}, "shared"),
                        ToolCallRequest("mcp_peer_read_file", {}, None),
                        ToolCallRequest("mcp_peer_other_tool", {}, "bad/" + ARGUMENT),
                    )
                )
            elif number == 2:
                # Claim the replacement itself, exercising a second rebind of
                # the same completed call and repeated tool names by identity.
                identifier = messages[2]["tool_calls"][0]["id"]
                self.claimed_id = identifier
                response = ChatModelResponse(
                    tool_calls=(
                        ToolCallRequest("echo", {"text": "native two"}, identifier),
                        ToolCallRequest("mcp_peer_read_file", {}, "stable"),
                    )
                )
            elif fallback:
                response = ChatModelResponse(
                    tool_calls=(
                        ToolCallRequest("echo", {"text": "unexecuted"}, "stable"),
                        ToolCallRequest(
                            "mcp_peer_read_file", {"value": ARGUMENT}, "shared"
                        ),
                    )
                )
            else:
                response = ChatModelResponse.from_text("done")
            self.responses = [response]
            return await super().complete(messages, tools=tools)

    model = LaterNativeModel("fake")
    runtime.chat_llm = model
    chunks = []

    async def capture(text):
        chunks.append(text)

    try:
        await runtime.start_mcp_tools()
        runtime.tool_selection.inject_manual(
            ("echo", "mcp_peer_read_file", "mcp_peer_other_tool")
        )
        processor = TurnProcessor(runtime)
        result = (
            await processor.process_streaming("synthetic", on_chunk=capture)
            if streaming
            else await processor.process("synthetic")
        )
        records = result.tool_calls
        assert len(records) == 8 and len({r.call_id for r in records}) == 8
        native = [r for r in records if r.mcp_provenance is None]
        assert native[0].call_id == "shared" and native[0].result == "native one"
        assert native[1].call_id == model.claimed_id and native[1].call_id != "shared"
        assert native[1].result == "native two"
        assert (
            records[1].call_id != "stable"
            if fallback
            else records[1].call_id == "stable"
        )
        retained = model.calls[-1]
        requests = [
            c
            for m in retained
            if m.get("role") == "assistant"
            for c in m.get("tool_calls", [])
        ]
        outputs = [m for m in retained if m.get("role") == "tool"]
        assert [c["id"] for c in requests] == [r.call_id for r in records]
        assert [m["tool_call_id"] for m in outputs] == [r.call_id for r in records]
        assert [m["content"] for m in outputs] == [r.result for r in records]
        for r in records:
            if r.mcp_provenance is not None:
                assert r.call_id == r.mcp_provenance.call_id
                assert r.arguments == {} and r.mcp_provenance.status == "succeeded"
        assert ARGUMENT not in repr(result) + repr(model.calls) + repr(chunks)
        if production:
            entry = (await store.get_entries("pairs"))[0]
            assert [c.id for c in entry.tool_calls] == [r.call_id for r in records]
            for call, output in zip(entry.tool_calls, entry.tool_results, strict=True):
                if call.mcp_provenance is not None:
                    assert call.mcp_provenance == output.mcp_provenance
                    assert call.mcp_provenance.transcript_correlation_id == entry.id
            output = io.StringIO()
            await JSONLExporter(store).export_session("pairs", output)
            exported = json.loads(output.getvalue().splitlines()[-1])
            assert exported["tool_calls"] == [
                c.model_dump(mode="json") for c in entry.tool_calls
            ]
        else:
            assert runtime.transcript.interactions[0].tool_calls == records
        if fallback:
            assert result.assistant_message.startswith("Tool results:")
            assert json.loads(result.raw_response)["tool_calls"][0]["id"] == "stable"
        else:
            assert result.assistant_message == "done"
        await bridge.stop()
        assert_stopped(bridge, processes)
    finally:
        await bridge.stop()

        )
assert [c["id"] for c in requests] == [r.call_id for r in records]

assert [m["content"] for m in outputs] == [r.result for r in records]

    tmp_path, processes, production, streaming
):
    runtime = build_runtime(config())
    bridge = install(runtime, tmp_path)
    store = SQLiteTranscriptStore(tmp_path / "transcript.sqlite")
    if production:
        runtime.transcript = FrameworkTranscriptAdapter(
            store, runtime.config, "session1"
        )
    try:
        await runtime.start_mcp_tools()
        runtime.tool_selection.inject_manual(
            ("echo", "mcp_peer_read_file", "mcp_peer_other_tool")
        )
        model = FakeChatModel(
            "fake",
            responses=[
                ChatModelResponse(
                    content=ARGUMENT,
                    reasoning_content=ARGUMENT,
                    raw_response={"unsafe": ARGUMENT},
                    tool_calls=(
                        ToolCallRequest(
                            "mcp_peer_read_file",
                            {"case": "echo", "value": ARGUMENT},
                            "shared",
                        ),
                        ToolCallRequest("echo", {"text": "native literal"}, "shared"),
                        ToolCallRequest(
                            "mcp_peer_other_tool",
                            {"case": "error", "value": ARGUMENT},
                            "shared",
                        ),
                        ToolCallRequest(
                            "mcp_peer_read_file",
                            {"case": "large", "value": ARGUMENT},
                            None,
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                ChatModelResponse.from_text("done"),
            ],
        )
        runtime.chat_llm = model
        chunks = []

        async def capture(text):
            chunks.append(text)

        processor = TurnProcessor(runtime)
        result = (
            await processor.process_streaming("fixture", on_chunk=capture)
            if streaming
            else await processor.process("fixture")
        )
        mcp = [c for c in result.tool_calls if c.mcp_provenance is not None]
        native = [c for c in result.tool_calls if c.mcp_provenance is None]
        assert len(mcp) == 3 and len(native) == 1
        assert len({c.call_id for c in result.tool_calls}) == 4
        assert native[0].call_id == "shared" and native[0].arguments == {
            "text": "native literal"
        }
        assert native[0].result == "native literal"
        assert [c.mcp_provenance.status for c in mcp] == [
            "succeeded",
            "failed",
            "succeeded",
        ]
        assert mcp[-1].mcp_provenance.result_truncated
        continuation = model.calls[1]
        assistant = continuation[2]
        assert assistant["content"] == "" and "reasoning_content" not in assistant
        assert [c["id"] for c in assistant["tool_calls"]] == [
            c.call_id for c in result.tool_calls
        ]
        assert [m["tool_call_id"] for m in continuation[3:]] == [
            c.call_id for c in result.tool_calls
        ]
        all_capture = repr(result) + repr(model.calls)
        if production:
            entries = await store.get_entries("session1")
            assert len(entries) == 1 and len(entries[0].tool_calls) == 4
            entry = entries[0]
            for call, output in zip(entry.tool_calls, entry.tool_results, strict=True):
                if call.mcp_provenance is not None:
                    assert (
                        call.arguments == {}
                        and output.mcp_provenance == call.mcp_provenance
                    )
                    assert call.mcp_provenance.transcript_correlation_id == entry.id
            logs = await store.get_context_log_for_session("session1")
            assert len(logs) == 1 and logs[0].entry_id == entry.id
            for exporter in [
                JSONLExporter(store),
                MarkdownExporter(store),
                CSVExporter(store),
            ]:
                output = io.StringIO()
                await exporter.export_session("session1", output)
                all_capture += output.getvalue()
            all_capture += repr(logs) + repr(entry)
        else:
            all_capture += repr(runtime.transcript.interactions) + repr(
                runtime.transcript.context_logs
            )
            assert runtime.transcript.interactions[0].tool_calls == result.tool_calls
        assert all(s not in all_capture for s in (ARGUMENT, ERROR, UNSAFE))
        assert all(
            c.arguments == {} and c.mcp_provenance.ingestion_decision == "disabled"
            for c in mcp
        )
        assert all(c.mcp_provenance.transcript_correlation_id is None for c in mcp)
        assert chunks == ["done"] if streaming else chunks == []
        await bridge.stop()
        assert_stopped(bridge, processes)
    finally:
        await bridge.stop()

            c.arguments == {} and c.mcp_provenance.ingestion_decision == "disabled"
            for c in mcp
        )

async def test_exhausted_pending_and_text_parsed_requests_cannot_leak(
    tmp_path, processes, streaming, text_call
):
    values = config().model_dump()
    values["tools"]["loop"] = {"max_iterations": 1}
    from friday_chat.config import FridayChatConfig

    runtime = build_runtime(FridayChatConfig.model_validate(values))
    bridge = install(runtime, tmp_path)
    try:
        await runtime.start_mcp_tools()
        runtime.tool_selection.inject_manual(("mcp_peer_read_file",))
        first = (
            ChatModelResponse.from_text(f'mcp_peer_read_file(value="{ARGUMENT}")')
            if text_call
            else ChatModelResponse(
                content=ARGUMENT,
                tool_calls=(
                    ToolCallRequest("mcp_peer_read_file", {"value": ARGUMENT}, "call1"),
                ),
            )
        )
        # Last response is still a pending request, never executed a second time.
        runtime.chat_llm = FakeChatModel(
            "fake",
            responses=[
                first,
                ChatModelResponse(
                    content=ARGUMENT,
                    tool_calls=(
                        ToolCallRequest(
                            "mcp_peer_read_file", {"value": ARGUMENT}, "bad/" + ARGUMENT
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ],
        )
        chunks = []

        async def capture(text):
            chunks.append(text)

        processor = TurnProcessor(runtime)
        result = (
            await processor.process_streaming("fixture", on_chunk=capture)
            if streaming
            else await processor.process("fixture")
        )
        assert len(result.tool_calls) == 1
        assert result.assistant_message.startswith("Tool results:")
        assert ARGUMENT not in repr(result) + repr(runtime.chat_llm.calls) + repr(
            runtime.transcript.interactions
        ) + repr(chunks)
        raw = json.loads(result.raw_response)
        assert raw["content"] == "" and raw["tool_calls"][0]["arguments"] == {}
    finally:
        await bridge.stop()
    assert_stopped(bridge, processes)

async def test_native_legacy_adapter_shape_and_export_controls(tmp_path):
    store = SQLiteTranscriptStore(tmp_path / "native.sqlite")
    adapter = FrameworkTranscriptAdapter(store, config(), "session1")
    call = ToolCallRecord(
        "echo", {"text": "native input"}, "native result", "legacy/native-id"
    )
    await adapter.record_interaction(
        InteractionTurn(
            "legacy/entry",
            "user",
            "assistant",
            "p",
            "c",
            (),
            TurnMetrics(0, 0, 0, 0),
            tool_calls=(call,),
        )
    )
    entry = (await store.get_entries("session1"))[0]
    assert entry.tool_calls[0].model_dump() == {
        "id": "legacy/native-id",
        "name": "echo",
        "arguments": {"text": "native input"},
    }
    assert entry.tool_results[0].model_dump() == {
        "tool_call_id": "legacy/native-id",
        "output": "native result",
        "error": None,
    }
    out = io.StringIO()
    await JSONLExporter(store).export_session("session1", out, include_metadata=False)
    payload = json.loads(out.getvalue().splitlines()[-1])
    assert "tool_calls" not in payload
    out = io.StringIO()
    await MarkdownExporter(store).export_session(
        "session1", out, include_tool_calls=True
    )
    assert "native input" in out.getvalue() and "native result" in out.getvalue()
    out = io.StringIO()
    await CSVExporter(store).export_session("session1", out)
    row = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(out.getvalue())))[0]
    assert json.loads(row["tool_calls"]) == [entry.tool_calls[0].model_dump()]

    store = SQLiteTranscriptStore(tmp_path / "native.sqlite")

            "legacy/entry",
            "user",
            "assistant",

        "id": "legacy/native-id",
        "name": "echo",
        "arguments": {"text": "native input"},
    }
    assert entry.tool_results[0].model_dump() == {
        "tool_call_id": "legacy/native-id",
        "output": "native result",
        "error": None,
    }
    out = io.StringIO()
    await JSONLExporter(store).export_session("session1", out, include_metadata=False)
    payload = json.loads(out.getvalue().splitlines()[-1])

    out = io.StringIO()
    await MarkdownExporter(store).export_session(

async def test_mcp_capture_policy_survives_public_stop_during_memory_await(
    tmp_path, processes, monkeypatch
):
    runtime = build_runtime(config())
    bridge = install(runtime, tmp_path)
    await runtime.start_mcp_tools()
    runtime.tool_selection.inject_manual(("mcp_peer_read_file",))
    original = runtime.memory.retrieve

    async def stop_before_model(query, *, token_limit):
        await bridge.stop()
        return await original(query, token_limit=token_limit)

    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.memory, "retrieve", stop_before_model)
    runtime.chat_llm = FakeChatModel(
        "fake",
        responses=[
            ChatModelResponse(
                content=ARGUMENT,
                tool_calls=(
                    ToolCallRequest(
                        "mcp_peer_read_file", {"value": ARGUMENT}, "bad/" + ARGUMENT
                    ),
                ),
            )
        ],
    )
    try:
        result = await TurnProcessor(runtime).process("fixture")
        assert result.tool_calls == ()  # Nothing executed after the public stop.
        assert ARGUMENT not in repr(result) + repr(
            runtime.transcript.context_logs
        ) + repr(runtime.transcript.interactions)
        assert json.loads(result.raw_response)["tool_calls"][0]["arguments"] == {}
    finally:
        await bridge.stop()
    assert_stopped(bridge, processes)

async def test_tiny_result_limit_is_safe_turn_error_before_execution_or_persistence(
    tmp_path, processes, monkeypatch
):
    from friday_chat.turns.processor import TurnProcessingError

    runtime = build_runtime(config(1))
    bridge = install(runtime, tmp_path)
    requests = []
    try:
        await runtime.start_mcp_tools()
        runtime.tool_selection.inject_manual(("mcp_peer_read_file",))
        original = bridge.registry.get_callable

        def track(name):
            requests.append(name)
            return original(name)

        monkeypatch.setattr(bridge.registry, "get_callable", track)
        runtime.chat_llm = FakeChatModel(
            "fake",
            responses=[
                ChatModelResponse(
                    content=ARGUMENT,
                    tool_calls=(
                        ToolCallRequest(
                            "mcp_peer_read_file", {"value": ARGUMENT}, "call1"
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            ],
        )
        with pytest.raises(TurnProcessingError, match="too small") as caught:
            await TurnProcessor(runtime).process("fixture")
        assert ARGUMENT not in str(caught.value) and requests == []
        assert (
            runtime.transcript.interactions == []
            and runtime.transcript.context_logs == []
        )
        assert runtime.memory.stored_turns == []
    finally:
        await bridge.stop()
    assert_stopped(bridge, processes)

async def test_optional_mcp_receipt_rejects_actual_paired_fact_readback_mismatch(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from friday_chat.runtime import MCPTranscriptReceipt
    cfg = config()
    store = SQLiteTranscriptStore(tmp_path / "receipt.sqlite")
    adapter = FrameworkTranscriptAdapter(store, cfg, "receipt")
    record = MCPOutputPolicy(256).checked_record(metadata(), "call", "benign", {})
    correlated = record.mcp_provenance.model_copy(update={"transcript_correlation_id": "entry"})
    turn = InteractionTurn("entry", "user", "answer", "", "", (), TurnMetrics(0,0,0,0),
                           tool_calls=(replace(record, mcp_provenance=correlated),))
    receipt = await adapter.record_mcp_interaction(turn)
    assert receipt == MCPTranscriptReceipt("entry", (correlated,))
    original = store.get_entry
    async def mismatched(entry_id):
        entry = await original(entry_id)
        changed = correlated.model_copy(update={"transcript_correlation_id": "wrong"})
        # Bypass constructor validation only to simulate corrupted persisted facts.
        entry.tool_results[0] = entry.tool_results[0].model_copy(update={"mcp_provenance": changed})
        return entry
    monkeypatch.setattr(store, "get_entry", mismatched)
    monkeypatch.setattr(adapter, "record_interaction", _receipt_noop)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="inconsistent"):
        await adapter.record_mcp_interaction(turn)

async def test_real_chat_yaml_factory_selection_call_quarantine_transcript_memory(
    version, memory_enabled, tmp_path, monkeypatch, caplog
):
    helper = integration_helpers()
    token = "SYNTHETIC_CHAT_TOKEN_SENTINEL"
    monkeypatch.setenv("SYNTHETIC_REMOTE_REFERENCE", token)
    before = set(asyncio.all_tasks())
    async with helper.tls_peer(tmp_path, monkeypatch, version, bearer=token) as (
        entry,
        child,
        counter,
        wire,
        context,
    ):
        runtime, model, collections, recorder = real_chat_factory(
            tmp_path, monkeypatch, entry, memory_enabled=memory_enabled
        )
        native = runtime.mcp_tools.native.list_tools()
        try:
            await runtime.start_mcp_tools()
            runtime.tool_selection.inject_manual(("mcp_remote_echo",))
            model.responses = [
                ChatModelResponse(
                    tool_calls=(
                        ToolCallRequest(
                            "mcp_remote_echo",
                            {"text": "SYNTHETIC_ARGUMENT_SENTINEL"},
                            "one",
                        ),
                    )
                ),
                ChatModelResponse.from_text("done"),
            ]
            result = await TurnProcessor(runtime).process("synthetic request")
            assert len(result.tool_calls) == 1 and result.tool_calls[0].arguments == {}
            facts = result.tool_calls[0].mcp_provenance
            assert (
                facts.tool.transport == "streamable_http"
                and facts.tool.trust_level == "remote"
            )
            assert (
                facts.status == "succeeded" and facts.memory_ingested is memory_enabled
            )
            entries = await runtime.transcript.store.get_entries("http-chat-session")
            assert len(entries) == 1
            stored = entries[0]
            assert (
                stored.tool_calls[0].mcp_provenance
                == stored.tool_results[0].mcp_provenance
            )
            assert (
                stored.tool_calls[0].mcp_provenance.transcript_correlation_id
                == stored.id
            )
            assert await collections.short_term.count() == int(memory_enabled)
            assert "<untrusted_content" in result.tool_calls[0].result
            assert stored.tool_results[0].mcp_provenance.output_sanitization_state in {
                "unchanged",
                "sanitized",
            }
            exposed = (
                json.dumps(stored.model_dump(mode="json"))
                + repr(model.calls)
                + repr(recorder.events)
                + caplog.text
            )
            assert token not in exposed and "SYNTHETIC_ARGUMENT_SENTINEL" not in exposed
            calls = [
                r
                for r in helper.records(wire)
                if r.get("mcp-method", r.get("method")) == "tools/call"
            ]
            assert (
                len(calls) == 1
                and calls[0]["auth_matches"]
                and not calls[0]["trace_present"]
            )
            names = [event.name for event in recorder.events]
            assert (
                names.count("mcp.tool_call_start") == 1
                and names.count("mcp.tool_call_finish") == 1
            )
            links = [
                event for event in recorder.events if event.name == "execution.mcp_link"
            ]
            assert links
            assert all(
                event.data.get("turn_ref") and event.data.get("session_ref")
                for event in links
            )
            client = runtime.mcp_tools.provider.manager.get_client("remote")
            await runtime.stop_mcp_tools()
            await runtime.stop_mcp_tools()
            assert (
                runtime.tools.list_tools() == native
                and client.outstanding_http_owners == 0
            )
            assert runtime.mcp_tools.provider.owned_tool_names == ()
            recorder.capture_event("mcp.disconnect", {"reason": "success"})
            assert recorder.events[-1].name == "mcp.disconnect"
        finally:
            await runtime.stop_mcp_tools()
            await runtime.async_clients.close()
    assert not [task for task in asyncio.all_tasks() - before if not task.done()]

        entry,

        counter,
        wire,
        context,

            tmp_path, monkeypatch, entry
        )
        owner = runtime.mcp_tools
        try:
            with pytest.raises(
                ToolProviderLoadError, match="Required MCP server unavailable"
            ):
                await runtime.start_mcp_tools()
            assert (
                runtime.mcp_tools is owner
                and owner.provider.manager.connected_servers == []

async def test_public_retry_after_partial_outcome_preserves_owned_id(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch, failure
):
    runtime, memory, manager, store = setup(tmp_path)
    checked = MCPOutputPolicy(256).checked_record(
        execution.metadata(), "call", "benign", {}
    )
    turn = make_turn("same-entry", calls=(checked,))
    policy = runtime.config.tools.mcp_provider.config.ingestion
    original_record = runtime.transcript.record_mcp_interaction
    original_append = store.append_entry
    original_read = store.get_entry
    original_publish = memory.publish_mcp_memory
    observed = []
    if failure == "false_append":
        async def false_append(entry):
            return False
        monkeypatch.setattr(store, "append_entry", false_append)
    elif failure == "ambiguous":
        async def ambiguous(value):
            await original_record(value)
            raise RuntimeError("RAW_SYNTHETIC_FAILURE")
        monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.transcript, "record_mcp_interaction", ambiguous)
    elif failure == "readback":
        appended = False
        async def append_then_fail(entry):
            nonlocal appended
            result = await original_append(entry)
            appended = True
            return result
        async def failed_read(entry_id):
            if appended:
                raise RuntimeError("RAW_SYNTHETIC_FAILURE")
            return await original_read(entry_id)
        monkeypatch.setattr(store, "append_entry", append_then_fail)
        monkeypatch.setattr(store, "get_entry", failed_read)
    elif failure == "publish":
        async def false_publish(snapshot):
            return False
        monkeypatch.setattr(memory, "publish_mcp_memory", false_publish)
    else:
        async def cancelled(value):
            await original_record(value)
            raise asyncio.CancelledError()
        monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.transcript, "record_mcp_interaction", cancelled)
    if failure in {"false_append", "readback", "cancel"}:
        with pytest.raises((RuntimeError, asyncio.CancelledError)):
            await persist_mcp_interaction(memory, runtime.transcript, policy, turn)
    else:
        first_calls = await persist_mcp_interaction(
            memory, runtime.transcript, policy, turn,
            observe=lambda name, outcome: observed.append((name, outcome)),
        )
        assert first_calls[0].mcp_provenance.memory_ingested
    rows = await manager.get_all()
    assert len(rows) == 1
    owned_id = rows[0]["id"]
    writes = manager._embedding_function.writes
    if failure == "false_append":
        assert await store.get_entry(turn.turn_id) is None
    elif failure != "readback":
        assert (await store.get_entry(turn.turn_id)) is not None
    if failure == "publish":
        assert (await manager.get_mcp_snapshot(owned_id)).state == "pending"
        assert observed == [("mcp_peer_read_file", "pending")]
    monkeypatch.setattr(store, "append_entry", original_append)
    monkeypatch.setattr(store, "get_entry", original_read)
    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.transcript, "record_mcp_interaction", original_record)
    monkeypatch.setattr(memory, "publish_mcp_memory", original_publish)
    retried = await persist_mcp_interaction(
        memory, runtime.transcript, policy, turn,
        observe=lambda name, outcome: observed.append((name, outcome)),
    )
    assert retried[0].mcp_provenance.memory_correlation_id == owned_id
    assert manager._embedding_function.writes == writes
    assert await manager.short_term.count() == 1
    assert await store.count_entries("memory-session") == 1
    assert (await manager.get_mcp_snapshot(owned_id)).state == "committed"
    assert observed[-1] == ("mcp_peer_read_file", "published")

                    ),

    )

        )

        assert len(entries) == 1 and len(entries[0].tool_calls) == 2

        ):

            assert call.mcp_provenance.memory_ingested is enabled
            assert call.mcp_provenance.transcript_correlation_id == entry.id
            if enabled:

                durable = await manager.get_mcp_snapshot(
                    call.mcp_provenance.memory_correlation_id
                )

                    durable.snapshot.call == call.mcp_provenance
                    and durable.state == "committed"
                )
                assert durable.snapshot.transcript_entry_id == entry.id
                assert (
                    execution.ARGUMENT
                    not in durable.text + durable.snapshot.encoded_provenance()
                )
            else:
                assert call.mcp_provenance.memory_correlation_id is None
        outputs = []
        for exporter, flags in (
            (JSONLExporter(store), {"include_metadata": True}),

            (MarkdownExporter(store), {"include_tool_calls": True}),
            (CSVExporter(store), {}),
        ):
            out = io.StringIO()
            await exporter.export_session("memory-session", out, **flags)
            outputs.append(out.getvalue())
        if enabled:
            exported = next(
                json.loads(line)
                for line in outputs[0].splitlines()

            )

            )

            )
            assert "MCP snapshot" not in "\n".join(

            )
        assert (

):
    runtime, memory, manager, store = setup(tmp_path)
    record = MCPOutputPolicy(256).checked_record(
        execution.metadata(), "call", "benign", {}
    )
    turn = make_turn("entry", calls=(record,))
    original = runtime.transcript.record_mcp_interaction
    if failure == "append":

        async def append(entry):
            return False

        monkeypatch.setattr(store, "append_entry", append)
    elif failure == "readback":

        async def wrong(turn):
            await original(turn)
            return MCPTranscriptReceipt("wrong", ())

        monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.transcript, "record_mcp_interaction", wrong)
    elif failure == "cancel":

        async def interrupted(turn):
            await original(turn)
            raise asyncio.CancelledError()

        monkeypatch.setattr(runtime.transcript, "record_mcp_interaction", interrupted)
    else:

        async def false(snapshot):
            return False

        monkeypatch.setattr(memory, "publish_mcp_memory", false)
    if failure == "publish":
        calls = await persist_mcp_interaction(
            memory,
            runtime.transcript,
            runtime.config.tools.mcp_provider.config.ingestion,
            turn,
        )
        assert calls[0].mcp_provenance.memory_ingested
    else:
        with pytest.raises((RuntimeError, asyncio.CancelledError)):
            await persist_mcp_interaction(

                runtime.transcript,
                runtime.config.tools.mcp_provider.config.ingestion,

    records = await manager.get_all()

        assert (

        )

async def test_concurrent_turns_and_budget_forwarding(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    runtime, memory, manager, store = setup(tmp_path)
    record = MCPOutputPolicy(256).checked_record(
        execution.metadata(), "call", "benign", {}
    )
    # Different owned turn IDs may share call names and call IDs without sharing storage.
    turns = [make_turn(f"entry-{i}", calls=(record,)) for i in range(2)]
    await asyncio.gather(
        *(
            persist_mcp_interaction(
                memory,
                runtime.transcript,
                runtime.config.tools.mcp_provider.config.ingestion,
                t,
            )
            for t in turns
        )
    )
    rows = await manager.get_all()
    assert len(rows) == 2 and len({r["id"] for r in rows}) == 2
    calls = []
    original = memory.controller.recall

    async def spy(*args, **kwargs):
        calls.append(kwargs["token_limit"])
        return await original(*args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(memory.controller, "recall", spy)
    await memory.retrieve("result", token_limit=777)
    await memory.retrieve("result", token_limit=0)
    assert calls == [777, 0]
    assert {r["metadata"]["mcp_state"] for r in rows} == {"committed"}

    oversized_characters = json.dumps(["x" * 33_000], separators=(",", ":"))
    oversized_bytes = json.dumps(
        ["😀" * 9_000],
        ensure_ascii=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    )

    async def raw_short_records(
        *,
        limit: int | None = None,
        where: dict[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
        del limit, where
        return [
            {
                "id": "oversized-characters",
                "text": "Oversized character lineage.",
                "metadata": {
                    "type": "meta_insight",
                    "source_count": 33_000,
                    "source_memories": oversized_characters,
                },
            },
            {
                "id": "oversized-bytes",
                "text": "Oversized byte lineage.",
                "metadata": {
                    "type": "meta_insight",
                    "source_count": 9_000,
                    "source_memories": oversized_bytes,
                },
            },

        *,

async def test_ingestion_count_and_background_handoff():
    r = build_runtime(config())
    result = await TurnProcessor(r).process("safe")
    manager = BackgroundTaskManager()
    coordinator = BackgroundWorkCoordinator(r, manager)

    class Controller:

async def test_explicit_none_mixed_origins_isolate_active_foreground_and_accounting(mode):
    from friday_telemetry import CompositeProvider
    sinks = [ContextSink(), ContextSink()]
    o = ChatTelemetryObserver(enabled=True, session_id="private", provider=CompositeProvider(sinks))
    origins = [o.correlation.context(turn=True), None, o.correlation.context(turn=True)]
    seen = []
    attempts = 0
    class Extractor:
        async def extract(self, turn):
            nonlocal attempts
            attempts += 1
            seen.append(o.correlation.current().context.turn_ref)
            if mode == "retry" and attempts == 2:
                raise RuntimeError("PRIVATE_PRIMARY")
            return {}
    adapter = FrameworkMaintenanceAdapter(config(), "private", None, None, None, {}, {},
        extractor=None if mode == "none" else Extractor(), observer=o)
    items = [PendingExtractionTurn(str(i), "PRIVATE_U", "PRIVATE_A", origin) for i, origin in enumerate(origins)]
    adapter.pending_extraction = items.copy()
    with turn_scope(o, "completion"):
        foreground = o.correlation.current()
        with suppress(RuntimeError):
            await adapter.flush_pending_extraction()
        assert o.correlation.current() is foreground
        assert foreground.accounting.completed_tools == foreground.accounting.failed_tools == 0
        assert foreground.accounting.persistence == "not_started"
        if mode == "retry":
            assert adapter.pending_extraction == items[1:]
            assert adapter.pending_extraction[0] is items[1]
            await adapter.flush_pending_extraction()
        assert not adapter.pending_extraction
        assert all(s.stack.get() == () for s in sinks)
    finishes = [dict(e.attributes) for e in o.snapshot().events if e.name == "execution.operation_finish"]
    expected = [origins[0].turn_ref, None, None, origins[2].turn_ref] if mode == "retry" else [origins[0].turn_ref, None, origins[2].turn_ref]
    assert [e.get("turn_ref") for e in finishes] == expected
    assert not o._spans and o.correlation.current() is None
    for sink in sinks:
        extraction = [s for s in sink.spans.values() if any(n == "execution.operation_start" for n, d in s["events"])]
        assert len(extraction) == len(expected) and all(s["parent"] is None and s["closed"] for s in extraction)
        assert "PRIVATE" not in repr(sink.events)

assert all(s.stack.get() == () for s in sinks)

async def test_gate_closure_wakes_and_rejects_queued_shared_waiter() -> None:
    gate = MaintenanceAdmissionGate()
    exclusive_entered = asyncio.Event()
    release_exclusive = asyncio.Event()

    async def hold_exclusive() -> None:
        async with gate.exclusive("test-exclusive"):
            exclusive_entered.set()
            await release_exclusive.wait()

    async def wait_shared() -> None:
        async with gate.shared("queued-shared"):
            raise AssertionError("closed shared waiter was admitted")

    exclusive = asyncio.create_task(hold_exclusive())
    await exclusive_entered.wait()
    shared = asyncio.create_task(wait_shared())
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    assert not shared.done()

    await gate.close_shared_admission()
    with pytest.raises(MaintenanceAdmissionError, match="closed"):
        await shared
    release_exclusive.set()
    await exclusive
